name: FirePlus-LHD Digital Linear Heat Detection cable 68°C PVC Coated
subtitle: Available in 50m, 100m, 200m, 500m and 1000m Reels
legacyName: FirePlus-LHD Digital Linear Heat Detection cable 68°C PVC Coated- UL Listed. Available in 50m, 100m, 200m, 500m and 1000m Reels
summary: Designed to monitor and trigger a response when a specific temperature is reached. If the temperature surrounding the cable reaches the activation temperature, the two cores quickly come into contact and trigger an alarm.
description: It is possible to connect 3,000 metres to any typical conventional or addressable fire alarm control panel or building management system providing greater protection than can be achieved using multiple discrete sensors.
features: Every inch of the Digital Linear Heat Detection cable act as the sensor providing extensive and comprehensive detection over large areas.
Respond well to an overheat situation in noisy, dusty or hazardous environments where other types of detectors may trigger false alarms.
Detection along the entire length of sensor cable.
Optional Nylon coating, offering UV protection and increased durability.
Optional Polypropylene coating for increased chemical protection.
Optional Stainless Steel over-braiding for increased mechanical protection.
